narr: Pulse convection and thunderstorms produced localized areas of nearly stationary, intense rainfall and hail ranging from pea sized to 1 inch in diameter during the afternoon and evening of September 11th.
ev: The Idaho County Sheriff's Office Facebook page reported washouts and subsequent closure on Reservation Line Road near Cottonwood Creek due to heavy rainfall from thunderstorms. A Flood Advisory for the area was issued on the evening of the 11th. The Sheriff's office reported that the road reopened by 1320 PST on the 12th.
